goal: Measure reproducible integer-only learning of raw variable binding from new synthetic cohorts, then test 7/9-hop novel role/topology transfer including adversarial near-collision encoded symbols.
source: Read existing F118/F120 source-verified GenEnv environment vectors, no new model inference. New independent in-repository F123 hash-counter graph generator, no F122 graph or RNG to produce F123 cohorts.

arms.I: Integer-only 25-parameter signed-bilinear perceptron over two separately SHA-projected raw 24-bit variable codes; per-bit pair interactions are inductive bias, not precomputed equality flags. 100 epochs; bounded integer updates; no native floating point in training, prediction, or parameter serialization.
arms.CTRL_RAW_EXACT: Exact equality of raw IDs, ceiling only; never a model feature

cohorts.heldout_near_collision_even_seeds: Swap distractor's encoded raw-variable token to differ in exactly one bit from changed junction's incoming token; preserve unique per-graph symbol projection, raw graph marginals and both-arm token consistency. Every even confirmation seed must be hard.
cohorts.frozen_training_update_order: For each epoch: source candidate index ascending, seed ascending, positive intervention junction then counterfactual negative intervention junction.
cohorts.train_only_selection: Only one integer arm, no confirmation-based threshold or design changes; score threshold signed_margin > 0
cohorts.require_topology_motifs: Deep held-out crosslinks, unreachable branches and cycles, off-role forks and reconvergence; unique valid role path for oracle and model

controls.graph_pair: Same graph topology and global multiset of original variable slots for positive and negative. Negative swaps a target path input with role-incompatible decoy input, destroying exactly one binding junction.
controls.model_inputs: Only two 24-bit token vectors, no IDs, labels, role names, seeds, oracle truth, precomputed equality, hamming count or side-channel. Pair bitwise products computed within trainable mechanism.
controls.heldout: Immutable novel generator seeds, role names, node topology, longer paths, token namespace; no training or selection using confirmation
controls.report: All train and confirmation cohorts; total and hard split pair accuracy; raw comparator upper bound and weak controls; full integer weights and SHA256 digest; source and model digests; development only
controls.cross_os: Bit-identical UTF-8 canonical report, integer weight hash, frozen input digests and all predictions between hosted Ubuntu and Windows, checked by a dependent verification job.
controls.failure: If any input collision or malformed invariant, quarantine. Preserve negatives. Do not tune after viewing confirmation.
controls.success_definition: Determinism is successful only if same exact-head input yields identical reports across operating systems. Transfer is separately measured; symbolic parity or better is not claimed without actual evidence.
